decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field as a key piece in a powerful combo strategy. By ramping up mana quickly with cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Arboreal Grazer, the deck aims to cast Emergent Ultimatum to search for game-winning spells like Omniscience or Dark Petition. Thespian's Stage and Hidden Strings can also be used to generate additional mana or untap Lotus Field for even more explosive plays. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its powerful combo potential and ability to quickly assemble game-winning combinations.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, using low-cost creatures and pump effects to quickly build a threatening board presence. By playing a combination of creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, along with protection spells like Brave the Elements, the deck aims to maintain pressure and control the battlefield. With aggressive creatures, combat tricks, and resilient threats, this deck is designed to quickly close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire, the deck aims to deal large amounts of damage early in the game. Atarka's Command provides additional reach and utility, while cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Reckless Bushwhacker help maintain pressure on opponents. The mana base is optimized for consistent early-game aggression, with lands like Stomping Ground and Den of the Bugbear facilitating quick starts.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly develop a board presence with efficient creatures like Righteous Valkyrie, Bishop of Wings, and Resplendent Angel, while utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of creatures and utilize cards like Kayla's Reconstruction and Inspiring Overseer to buff and protect them. Collected Company allows for explosive turns by being able to put multiple creatures into play at instant speed, putting pressure on the opponent early in the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently play Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard by casting multiple spells in a single turn. It relies on cheap instants and sorceries to trigger the Phoenix's ability, as well as card draw and selection to find the necessary pieces. The deck also includes some disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Galvanic Iteration to protect and optimize its game plan. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with quick, recurring threats while maintaining card advantage and tempo.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Shark Typhoon from the deck. With cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Secrets of the Key to support the combo, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with unexpected threats. The deck also includes various spells and lands to control the board and protect the combo pieces, showcasing a blend of creativity and strategic thinking in its gameplay.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays with cards like Reckless Bushwhacker, Venerated Loxodon, and Resolute Reinforcements to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes efficient creatures like Thraben Inspector and Giant Killer to control the board. The use of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion ensures that the deck maintains consistency and power throughout the game. With a mix of low-cost creatures and powerful combat tricks, this deck aims to quickly close out the game by attacking relentlessly.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using cards like Lotus Field and various land-fetching spells, allowing for explosive and game-ending plays using cards like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. It also includes a variety of utility spells and creatures to help control the board and dig for key combo pieces. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces to create a powerful combo turn that overwhelms the opponent and secures victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, efficient creatures that can quickly build a wide board presence. By utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant to buff your creatures and give them pseudo-vigilance, combined with protection from Brave the Elements, it allows for aggressive and relentless attacks. The addition of cards like Skyclave Apparition and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, provide removal and board presence to maintain pressure. The deck aims to seize control early and maintain it throughout the game.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil to control the board and deal damage. It also includes cards like Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute for additional sacrifice synergy. The deck aims to create a steady stream of damage through sacrificing creatures and dealing damage to opponents. With cards like Fatal Push for removal and a versatile mana base, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive playstyle and efficient creature sacrifice combos.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The land base is designed to support the deck's two-color mana requirements efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to control the board with removal spells while deploying powerful creatures to quickly close out the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay using cheap creatures and combat tricks to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Venerated Loxodon help boost the team's power and toughness, while Giant Killer and Resolute Reinforcements provide versatility and additional threat. The inclusion of Castle Embereth and Gleeful Demolition adds extra reach and removal options, ensuring the deck can maintain pressure and adapt to different situations. Overall, this Boros Aggro deck aims to seize the early game advantage and close out the match swiftly with a relentless onslaught of creatures.

This deck focuses on aggressively sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful abilities, such as dealing damage to opponents with Mayhem Devil and gaining value with Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven. The goal is to apply pressure early on while disrupting the opponent's game plan with Thoughtseize and Claim the Firstborn. The deck also utilizes lands that can provide additional benefits or flexibility, such as Den of the Bugbear and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and synergy to the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana through green mana dorks and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx in order to cast big green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. It also utilizes cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival to further accelerate the deck's game plan. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator provides utility and disruption, while Boseiju, Who Endures helps protect important spells. Lair of the Hydra and Polukranos Reborn offer additional threats in the late game, making this deck a formidable aggro-devotion powerhouse in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's game plan through hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil. The deck includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Bonecrusher Giant to clear the way for its threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bloodtithe Harvester. The mana base is optimized for consistent black and red mana sources, with utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear providing additional value. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and control the game with a mix of creatures, removal, and disruption.
